sources.title: SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT: Text-to-Image model - aimodels.fyi
sources.snippet: Overview SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT is a native unified multimodal model built on the NEO-unify architecture that handles both image understanding and generation within a single framework. Created by sensenova, this 8-billion parameter model uses a mixture-of-tasks (MoT) approach with dense transformer layers and strengthened patchify mechanisms.

sources.title: SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT - Papers with Code
sources.snippet: Abstract SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT is an official native unified multimodal 8B MoT checkpoint from SenseNova. The release focuses on improved instruction following, text and layout generation, native 4K generation, image editing, and visual control, and reports changes to patchify layers, data quality and distribution, task formulation, prompt enhancement, and post-training.
